subject: Maple Financial: KMS/HSM custody evidence & rotation procedures request
messages:
From: Claire Morris <claire.morris@maplefinancial.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.example.com
Cc: security@maplefinancial.com
Date: 2027-08-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: CAIQ/SIG follow-up — encryption & key management artifacts

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our security team is running through the SIG and CAIQ for vendor onboarding and we need a compact package of artifacts relating to encryption and key management to close the review. Can you provide the following by EOD Friday (2027-08-20)?

- HSM vendor attestation or ATE (most recent) and wrap/ceremony minutes
- KMS access matrix (roles, IAM mappings, service accounts) for production tenancy
- Rotation logs (proof of automated rotation and manual emergency rotations) for the last 6 months
- Split-keystore / escrow procedures and evidence (if applicable)
- Transit and at-rest crypto configurations (algorithms, TLS ciphers, KDFs)
- Operator shift log sample (redacted) and explanation of separation of duties
- Any third-party penetration test or SOC-2 addendum relevant to key custody

If you prefer, we can accept this as a secure upload to the link below (SFTP or secure share). Also let us know if you need a short extension — we understand this can take coordination across teams.

Secure upload: https://redwood-secure-share.example.com/s/MapleEvidenceUpload

Thanks,
Claire Morris
Senior Security Analyst
Maple Financial

Claire — thanks for the clear list. We're on it. Per the items you requested, here's our proposed intake plan:

- Target delivery: initial artifact bundle by 2027-08-18 (will include HSM attestation PDF, KMS access matrix, rotation log samples).
- Finalized bundle (with operator shift logs and ceremony minutes) by 2027-08-20.
- Delivery method: secure share link (we will upload PDFs/CSV/Excel to the URL you provided) and provide checksums for each file.

Marissa, can you lead the artifact pull and coordinate with Jonas for the rotation log export and operator shift redaction? Jonas — if you can export the last 6 months of rotation events and include the emergency rotation entries and associated ticket IDs, that would help.

Claire — is there a minimal format you prefer for the access matrix (CSV vs Excel)? Also, do you need raw keystore blobs? We will not share any secret material — only metadata, logs, and attestations.

Thanks,

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>

Date: 2027-08-15T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Maple Financial: KMS/HSM custody evidence & rotation procedures request

Vanessa / Jonas — quick status and artifact list. I'll be the primary owner for the compliance packet and will upload to the secure share once files are assembled. Preliminary contents below (will attach as listed filenames):

1) HSM attestation (vendor: Thales) — maples_hsm_attestation_202706.pdf (contains vendor-signed attestation and hardware serials).
2) Wrap ceremony minutes — wrap-ceremony-minutes-2026-11.pdf (operator list, timestamps, signatures).
3) KMS access matrix — kms-access-matrix-2027-08.xlsx (columns: role, principal, service, permission, last_reviewed).
4) Rotation logs (automated + manual) — rotation-log-sample-2027-02-07_to_2027-07-31.csv (redacted token IDs; includes ticket refs: TKT-3124, TKT-3349 for emergency rotates).
5) Operator shift log (redacted) — operator-shift-log-sample-2027-06.txt (shows separation of duties, 2-person approval entries masked).
6) Crypto config summary — crypto-config-summary-2027-08.pdf (AES-256-GCM for at-rest, TLS 1.3 with curated cipher suite, KDF: HKDF-SHA256).
7) Escrow / split-keystore doc — split-keystore-procedures.pdf (process, escrow vendor SLA, retention).
8) SOC2 addendum pointer — soc2-sig-appendix-redwood.pdf (pointer to auditor report and relevant sections).

Notes / answers to Claire's questions:
- We will not provide private key material or raw keystore blobs.
- Rotation cadence: automated primary keys rotate every 90 days; tenant DEKs rotate on demand and can be forced via our emergency rotation playbook.
- Emergency rotation: operators open a ticket, two-operator approval required, and an automated rollback hold for 30 minutes to validate token integrity.
- Operator access: HSM operator roles are cycled quarterly; operator accounts are time-bound and require 2FA + recorded SSO session.

I'll assemble the bundle and upload to the secure share by COB 2027-08-18. Jonas — please attach the rotation log export and provide a brief README describing each column.

Marissa Cole
Principal Security Engineer — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.example.com
